snippet.title: The Demon Party Trailer English
snippet.description:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4300540/__The_Demon_Party/

With the Demon Lord gone, the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos as monsters wage a civil war to claim the throne.

Players take on the role of Lethe, a young Demon girl who was once the Demon Lord’s younger sister, and use her power of domination to subjugate defeated monsters and form a party of her own.

In battle, players can defeat hostile monsters and immediately turn useful ones into allies through domination. Dominated monsters each have their own stats, skills, and traits, allowing players to combine them into a party with various roles such as offense, defense, and support.

After clearing a stage or reaching game over, players return to their base, where they can train dominated monsters, prepare the party for the next battle, and craft items needed for combat.

Dominate more monsters, grow your base, and raise Lethe’s new Demon Lord army.
